head.title: React Blogger Theme Example
head.b:skin: body{background-color:#f3f4f6;margin:0;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;color:#1f2937}.header-container{background-color:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:15px 30px}.homepage-banner{padding:30px;background-color:#f9fafb;border-radius:8px;margin-top:15px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb}.homepage-banner h1{margin:0;color:#111827;font-size:24px}.homepage-banner p{margin:10px 0 0;color:#4b5563}.wrapper-pane{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px}.content-area{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;margin-top:20px}.post-item-view{background:#fff;padding:24px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px #0000001a;border:1px solid #e5e7eb}.post-item-view h2{margin-top:0;font-size:20px}.post-item-view h2 a{color:#2563eb;text-decoration:none}.post-item-view h2 a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.post-body{margin-top:12px;color:#374151;line-height:1.6}

div.p: A cutting-edge blog layout engineered entirely in TypeScript.
